description:
Initial Consultation 

The program begins with an initial consultation with a personal trainer. The initial consult consists of a 1.5 hour session in which the personal trainer will evaluate your current level of fitness, discuss and help you set goals and create a plan to get you closer to those fitness goals. Please dress in comfortable work-out clothes, wear indoor gym shoes, and bring a water bottle. 

Policies
  • Participants in the Personal Trainer Program must have current memberships at the PWSC Health & Fitness Center or pay the daily rate when working with the personal trainer. 
  • Participants must meet with the personal trainer at the Health & Fitness Center. Personal cannot meet at the participants home, the personal trainer home or any other gym. 
  • Appointment times with personal trainers must be respected. Rescheduling will be considered within reason as long as at least 24 hours notice is given. Cancellations with less than 24 or no-show will be charges the hourly personal trainer rate. If the personal trainer must cancel an appointment with less than 24 hours notice the client will receive one free session.
  • Client tardiness will be deducted from the appointment time, which is till full cost.
Getting Started 

Visit the Health & Fitness Center front desk to fill out a Client Information packet. Our staff will file your information safety away. A personal Trainer will call you at their earliest convenience to se up a consultation.
